A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

```python
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Choose candidate with fingers aligned along the pen's long axis (yaw ≈ -1.249)
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)

grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]

# Adjust yaw to align the pen's long axis with the target orientation
delta = target_yaw - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
rotate_by(delta)

carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
```

- After the program yellow_pen is offset [0.0068, 0.009] m from the centre of green_case ([0.009, 0.0068] m along / across the zone's long axis) (the zone half size along / across its long axis is [0.0765, 0.0221]); inside_zone=False, resting=False, gripper_holding=False.
